excerpts.text: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry has been awarded to Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar M. Yaghi “for the development of metal–organic frameworks.” Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) are porous materials comprised of metal ion or cluster nodes coordinated to organic linkers.

### [Chemistry Nobel for scientists who developed massively porous ‘super sponge’ materials](/articles/d41586-025-03195-1)

Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi pioneered the creation of metal–organic frameworks, which can capture and store molecules such as carbon dioxide.
